name: google-docs-mcp
description: Real Google Docs content editing and Google Drive file management via the official Docs API v1 and Drive API v3 — OAuth-authenticated, no third-party proxy.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: From Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials (Desktop app type). See docs/ONBOARDING.md.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Paired with the client ID above.

tools.name: google_docs
tools.description: Google Docs API v1 content editing (create, read, edit text/styles/tables).

tools.name: google_drive
tools.description: Google Drive API v3 file lifecycle (list, search, share, trash, comments).

tools.name: show_google_docs_status_app
tools.description: Prefab UI status card for auth/config state.
